title: Chicken or Turkey with Potatoes and Vegetables (No Sauce)

content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of roasted or boiled chicken or turkey, potatoes and vegetables (carrots, broccoli, dark‑green leafy greens). It is prepared without added sauces, preserving the natural flavors of the ingredients and making it easy to digest.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken and turkey are complete protein sources containing all essential amino acids.
Potatoes are one of the world’s most consumed root vegetables; they are rich in starch and vitamin C.
Broccoli is considered a “super‑vegetable” because of its high levels of vitamins C, K and folate.
Dark‑green leafy greens (spinach, kale, collard greens) are packed with iron and antioxidants.
The absence of sauce reduces added sugars and sodium, making the meal healthier.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Poultry meat provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C from potatoes and broccoli boosts the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Vitamin K and calcium from leafy greens help strengthen bones.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Fiber from vegetables and potatoes promotes healthy gut motility.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Phytonutrients in broccoli and leafy greens help neutralize free radicals.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken or turkey.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: When using processed meat or seasonings, monitor added salt levels.

items.title: Potential pathogens
items.content: Undercooked meat can harbor bacteria; ensure internal temperature reaches 75 °C.

items.title: Oxalates in leafy greens
items.content: People prone to kidney stones should consume spinach and kale in moderation.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot as a main meal. It can be sliced into portions, added to salads, or used as a filling for wraps.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cooked dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze in portion‑size bags for up to 2 months. Reheat to 75 °C before eating.
